capabilities: Render a hill chart from a hill-chart fenced code block
Drag chart dots to update positions written back to the code block
Link dots to notes via wiki-link labels
Theme chart colors with CSS variables and formats defaulting to currentColor
extras: Charts are self-contained in the vault with no external services; theme support uses currentColor defaults for light and dark themes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize and interactively update work progress as a hill chart without external services or hidden state.
summary: Renders draggable hill charts in code blocks to track Shape Up progress, with dots linked to notes and data stored as YAML in the note.
